# Agent Ops Command Center

Agent Ops Command Center is a Notion and spreadsheet template pack for builders running AI coding agents.

Primary page: https://ivelly42.github.io/agent-ops-command-center/

Preview: https://ivelly42.github.io/agent-ops-command-center/preview.md

Early access request: https://github.com/ivelly42/agent-ops-command-center/issues/new?template=order-request.yml

Preview release: https://github.com/ivelly42/agent-ops-command-center/releases/tag/v0.2-preview

Sample run log CSV: https://ivelly42.github.io/agent-ops-command-center/sample/run_log_sample.csv

## Summary

The product helps builders track AI coding-agent runs, prompt versions, verification commands, costs, and repeated failure modes.

## Full Pack Contents

- Notion-ready Markdown workspace
- Six CSV database imports
- Run brief template
- Review brief template
- Failure RCA template
- Weekly operator review

## Status

Paid checkout is not live. The public repo contains preview material only. The paid product ZIP is not published publicly.
